prior_batch_membership_bounds.scope: Nine already proposed Holodex groups; review of inspected complete titles/custom descriptions, plus current Graondstone lead. Not exhaustive historical absence proof.
findings: GrindStone=Kaela/Bijou duo. Graondstone=Kaela/Bijou/Raora trio separately established. Preserve as distinct records; do not union members or alias labels.
常MOS=Subaru/Mio/Okayu/Towa from exact four-person custom credits. Distinct from SMOK (Korone), already separate canonical candidate.
PizzaTimeSmith=Raora/Kaela/Kronii and SMITTEN=Raora/Kaela from named title and custom guest metadata. Distinct units; a guest appearance alone does not expand membership.

PavoNova=Moona/Reine; CeReines=Fauna/Reine; ReiRyS=IRyS/Reine; sharpea=Gura/Reine; pavonashi=Kiara/Reine. Each has uploader-owned named title and specific custom student/partner context. No observed alternate complete lineup in inspected primary records.
prior_batch_membership_bounds.recommended_bounds: Treat membership as the source-documented named lineup on the cited date. These sources establish named collaborations, not permanence, current activity or an exhaustive roster history.
